question: How do I apply for admission?
answer: Apply online through the admission portal: register with your email, fill in the application form, upload your mark sheets and ID proof, and pay the application fee. You will receive a confirmation email with your application number.
keywords: apply application form portal register

question: Which documents are required for admission?
answer: Bring originals and two photocopies of: 10th and 12th mark sheets, transfer certificate, entrance exam scorecard, passport-size photographs, government ID proof, and a caste or income certificate if you are claiming a reservation or scholarship.
keywords: documents papers certificates marksheet originals

question: What is the last date to apply?
answer: Applications for the 2026-27 intake close on 30 June 2026. Late applications are accepted until 10 July with a late fee of Rs 500, subject to seat availability.
keywords: deadline last date closing intake
alt_questions: Until when can I register for admission?

question: What is the fee structure?
answer: Annual tuition is Rs 85,000 for B.Tech and Rs 60,000 for diploma programmes. Additional charges: Rs 5,000 development fee and Rs 3,000 exam fee per year. Fees are payable in two instalments, July and December.
keywords: tuition fee cost annual instalment

question: How can I pay my fees?
answer: Fees can be paid online (UPI, net banking, debit/credit card) through the student portal, or by demand draft at the accounts office between 10 am and 3 pm on working days. Keep the receipt; it is required for hostel allotment.
keywords: pay online upi demand draft accounts receipt

question: What is the fee refund policy?
answer: If you withdraw before the session starts, 90% of tuition is refunded. Between the start of classes and 30 days later, 50% is refunded. After 30 days no tuition is refunded. Development and exam fees are non-refundable. Refunds take 15 working days.
keywords: refund withdraw cancel money back

question: Are scholarships available?
answer: Yes. Merit scholarships cover 25-100% of tuition for students ranking in the top 5% of the entrance exam. Government scholarships (including EBC and minority schemes) are available with valid certificates. Apply through the scholarship cell by 31 August.
keywords: scholarship merit financial aid EBC concession
alt_questions: Is there any financial aid for students?

question: How do I get a hostel room?
answer: Submit the hostel application on the student portal after your admission is confirmed. Rooms are allotted by merit and distance from home. A refundable deposit of Rs 10,000 and the first-term hostel fee are due at allotment.
keywords: hostel room allotment accommodation deposit
alt_questions: How to apply for hostel accommodation?

question: How much is the hostel fee?
answer: Hostel charges are Rs 45,000 per year for a shared room and Rs 70,000 for a single room. Mess charges of Rs 3,500 per month are billed separately.
keywords: hostel charges rent mess room cost

question: What are the hostel timings and visitor rules?
answer: Gates close at 10 pm for first-year students and 11 pm for others. Visitors are allowed in the common room from 4 pm to 7 pm with a signed entry. Overnight guests are not permitted.
keywords: hostel curfew gate visitors rules

question: When are the semester exams held?
answer: Odd-semester exams run from the first week of December; even-semester exams from the second week of May. The detailed timetable is published on the exam portal at least 21 days before the first paper.
keywords: exam timetable schedule semester dates
alt_questions: When will the exam timetable be released?

question: How do I download my hall ticket?
answer: Log in to the exam portal, open 'Hall Ticket' and download the PDF. It is available 7 days before the exam, and only if your fee dues are cleared and attendance is at least 75%. Carry a printed copy and your ID card.
keywords: hall ticket admit card download

question: How can I check my exam results?
answer: Results are published on the exam portal about 30 days after the last paper. Log in with your enrollment number and date of birth. For re-evaluation, apply within 7 days of the result at Rs 600 per subject.
keywords: result marks grade revaluation re-evaluation portal
alt_questions: Where do I see my marks?

question: What is the minimum attendance requirement?
answer: You need at least 75% attendance in each subject to appear for exams. Medical leave with a doctor's certificate submitted within 7 days can condone up to 10% shortfall, with approval from the head of department.
keywords: attendance 75 percent shortage condonation medical leave

question: What are the library timings?
answer: The central library is open 8 am to 9 pm on weekdays and 9 am to 5 pm on Saturdays. During exam weeks it stays open until midnight. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question: How many books can I borrow from the library?
answer: Undergraduate students may borrow 4 books for 14 days, renewable once online. A fine of Rs 2 per day applies for late returns. Lost books must be replaced or paid for at the current price.

answer: The training and placement cell runs aptitude and communication training from the third semester. Companies visit from August of the final year; eligible students (no active backlogs, minimum 60% marks) register on the placement portal and attend company-specific rounds.

question: How do I get a new ID card if I lose mine?
answer: Report the loss to the administrative office, submit a written application with a Rs 200 fee receipt and a passport-size photograph. A replacement card is issued within 5 working days.

question: How do I connect to campus Wi-Fi?
answer: Select the network 'Campus-Secure', then sign in with your student portal username and password. Each student may register up to 3 devices. For connection problems visit the IT help desk in Block B, room 105.

question: I forgot my student portal password. How do I reset it?
answer: On the login page click 'Forgot password' and enter your enrollment number. A reset link is sent to your registered email. If you no longer have access to that email, visit the IT help desk with your ID card.

question: Is a college bus service available?
